mod.name: TB Carry
mod.summary: Lets players pick up and carry other players. Carried players are handled with the TBCPlayerBaseBodyBag item. It has one small config file.
mod.notes: Needs TBLib on server and clients. Admin rights come from Global/AdminConfig (carry).

files.title: Carry settings
files.summary: The only setting of the mod: whether bot (NPC) corpses can be packed and carried.

version.label: Config version
version.help: Internal version number of this file format. The mod manages it; do not edit.

isInitialized.label: Initialised marker
isInitialized.help: Internal marker the mod sets after it has created the file. Do not change it.

enablePackActionOnBots.label: Allow packing bots
enablePackActionOnBots.help: 1 lets players pack bot (NPC) corpses like players; 0 blocks it, which suits servers with NPC characters that must stay in place.
